summary: The diff implements all 7 requirements comprehensively. All sections (Hero, About, Programs, Gallery, Contact, Navbar) are present with correct content, backend storage, form validation, and cricket-themed visual design. No significant missing requirements were found. A few minor hallucinated features were added beyond the spec.

hallucinated_features.description: Gallery lightbox modal with prev/next navigation was added to the Gallery section
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec only requires a responsive grid layout for the gallery. A full lightbox with keyboard/click navigation was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Social media links (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) added in the Footer
hallucinated_features.reason: No social media links or social media presence was mentioned in the build request requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Stats row (500+ Students Trained, 7+ Years Min. Age, 15+ Expert Coaches) added in Hero section
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not specify any statistics or numbers to display in the Hero section beyond the academy name, tagline, and CTA button.
